component: EML browser-test window and picker ownership

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Correction to dcb7a7ef7aedd9a34aa25ed706e58ec7abcdebba540811c0aa9687a604dbb6dd: these EML tests open messageWindow.xhtml, including the secondary window for an attached EML. The later accepted follow-up binds MockFilePicker to the message window that opens the picker and awaits focus on msgc2. Keep that target-window advice, but do not describe this evidence as multiple compose windows. The first 2025 patch adds only the loaded-state wait and unique task names; later focus, mock context and file-content checks are separate phases. No picker or window was run.
title: The EML picker follow-up concerns message windows, not compose windows
